name: mobile-command-center
rationale: Phase 3 is the one remaining task with NO objectively correct answer. What belongs in a merchant's first phone viewport is a judgement call, and a single agent producing one layout gives nothing to compare it against. Generator-variants plus a judge is the right shape — and it is the ONLY task here that earns the extra cost of competition.
why_not_parallel: Parallel fan-out divides independent work. Competition runs the SAME task N times to choose among variants. Using competition for the other phases would pay N times the cost to solve problems that already have a machine-checkable right answer.

generator.task: Design and implement the mobile home command center. First viewport must answer, in order: HEALTH → MOST IMPORTANT CHANGE → MOST IMPORTANT PROBLEM → RECOMMENDED ACTION.
hard_constraints: Render ONLY from dashData.intelligence / dashData.funnel / dashData.resultBreakdown — the deterministic P0-P5 output
No analytics computation in JavaScript. If a needed value is absent from the DTO, STOP and report it as a contract gap
Confidence must be visible, including INSUFFICIENT_DATA
Mixed-purpose accounts show per-unit results, never a fabricated single total
generator.differentiator: Each variant must take a DIFFERENT position on the central question: how much to show before the fold. Variant A: single verdict only. Variant B: verdict + funnel break. Variant C: verdict + per-unit results + action.

evaluator.note: A variant failing any gate is disqualified before judging. Taste is only consulted among correct implementations.

rubric.measure: vertical px from viewport top to the recommended action
renders INSUFFICIENT_DATA and approximate labels without hiding them
primary action within the bottom 60% of a 780px viewport
screens to scroll for the full first answer; fewer is better
does not show a metric the objective does not care about

evaluator.tie_break: prefer the variant that shows LESS — a phone command center is judged by what it omits

budgets.context_policy: Each variant receives the DTO shape, the audit density findings (dashboard: 4569px, 5.9 screens, first action at 158px), and the P4 renderer as prior art. Not the analytics implementation history.

failure_policy.all_variants_fail_gates: report and stop — do not merge a variant that breaks the analytics boundary to win on aesthetics
failure_policy.single_variant_passes: merge it without a competition; note that the comparison was not meaningful
